worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.summary: Scatter magic powder over the target and rewrite all of its current types into pure Psychic; Grass-type bodies shake the powder off and are fully immune.
worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.use.0: rewrite a foe as Psychic and open Bug, Ghost and Dark weaknesses
worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.use.1: strip a foe of its own STAB and defensive profile
worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.use.2: hold the rewrite longer with the sift option
worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.descriptio: Rewrite all of the target's current types into pure Psychic for %1$s; about %2$s powder motes (more with Special Attack).
Scatter range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, following speed and size.
Powder cloud radius about %1$s blocks, about %2$s psychic glints, powder speed about %3$s blocks/tick; larger and heavier bodies show more.
worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.sift.on: Sift: rewrite lasts %1$s and range shortens to %2$s blocks, with a slower wind-up and longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.sift.off: Single flick: longer range, faster wind-up, %1$s cooldown, but a shorter rewrite.
worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.magicpowder.preference: On = Sift: range x0.65, +2 wind-up, +14 cooldown, in exchange for x1.7 rewrite duration; off = single flick: longer range, faster wind-up, shorter cooldown, but a shorter rewrite. Range trades against duration.
The companion only considers powdering a threat within this distance; lower stays close, higher chases further.
When on, it will leave its post to scatter powder.
world_combat.move.magicpowder.text.immun: Grass-type shook the powder off; it has no effect
world_combat.move.magicpowder.text.wipe: The magic powder drifts away; its type returns
world_combat.move.magicpowder.text.fizzl: Already pure Psychic, nothing to rewrite
